data = open('/workspace/testcase.bin', 'rb').read()[:32768]
# Find positions where a triple-quote starts a new token
# A new token starts after whitespace, =, {, }, #, or at the beginning
import re
# Find all positions of triple quotes
positions = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(b'\"\"\"', data)]
# Check which ones are at token boundaries
for pos in positions[:20]:
    prev = data[pos-1] if pos > 0 else None
    print(f'pos={pos}, prev={prev!r}, prev_char={chr(prev) if prev else \"start\"}, context={data[max(0,pos-5):pos+10]!r}')
"
